label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 009 ]

blocks.text: Today, the industrial economy is changing into a knowledge economy based on science and technology. Clearly, modern societies are facing a major change into a new economic system where human resourcefulness count far more than natural resources. It is brain power that can guarantee our economic success in the midst of the fierce competition of the current free world market.

readingSentences.english: Today, the industrial economy is changing into a knowledge economy based on science and technology.
readingSentences.korean: 오늘날 산업 경제가, 과학과 기술에 기초를 둔 정보경제로 변하고 있다.

readingSentences.english: Clearly, modern societies are facing a major change into a new economic system where human resourcefulness count far more than natural resources.
readingSentences.korean: 분명히 현대사회는 인적자원이 천연자원보다 훨씬 중요한 새로운 경제 체제로의 커다란 변화에 직면하고 있다.

readingSentences.english: It is brain power that can guarantee our economic success in the midst of the fierce competition of the current free world market.
readingSentences.korean: 현재의 자유세계시장의 격렬한 경쟁의 와중에 경제적 성장을 보장할 수 있는 것은 바로 지적인 힘인 것이다.
